observations.description: Alert event IDs recomputed canonically: event_id must equal _digest(body without event_id). Duplicates, missing, wrong event_id, trading_authority=true all reject.
Sensitive field names (password, api_key, private_key, secret, credential, token) recursively rejected from alert spool. Nested fields also rejected.

Sink manifest: exact schema (5 keys), stable identity (lowercase alnum), eligible transport (UNC/CLOUD_SYNC/REMOVABLE), off_host_attested=True, trading_authority=False. Missing/extra/wrong/malformed all reject.
Delivery envelopes: deterministic (delivery_id=sha256(sink:alert)), atomic (.tmp-{pid}-{uuid}+os.replace), immutable (conflicting existing rejects), read-back verified (re-read matches).
Receipts: content-verified (receipt_id=_digest(body)), tampered receipt rejects, idempotent retry returns same receipt.
Acknowledgements: exact identity (ack_id=_digest(body)), matching receipt, valid chronology (delivered<=ack<=now+1min), valid operator (_IDENTITY regex), bounded SLA. Zero/negative SLA rejects.

Future/early/late/malformed/duplicate/conflicting/authority/unknown acks all fail closed: wrong authentication, wrong sink, wrong schema, extra fields, missing receipt, authority escalation, chronology, SLA breach.
Atomic writes via .tmp-{pid}-{uuid}+os.replace. No temp files remaining. Read-back verification detects corruption.
Module states 'does not authenticate an operator' and 'not physically off-host'. UNAUTHENTICATED_OPERATOR_ATTESTATION is the only accepted authentication value.
Foundation disclaims completed off-host delivery, institutional readiness, and trading authority. States not cryptographically authenticated.
No network/credential imports: no requests/httpx/socket/urllib/smtplib. os used only for os.replace, os.getpid, os.fsync. No Get-Credential/keyring/vault.
